clean.tl: He himself will come.' (<Y>: indicates palatalization of the following consonant)

orig.tl: He himself will come.' (<Y>: indicates palatalization of the following consonant)

clean.tl: I have built my house myself.' (<N>: indicates prenasalization of the following consonant)
John saw himself in the mirror.

clean.tx: Ytsamhayu teʔ Ytɨwɨ ke tɨhkɨyu wakas Yneʔ Ykamaʔohmo
clean.tl: He told his friend that cows had entered his own cornfield.

flagged.tx: naytyumɨ Y teʔ tsaʔma waʔy Ytsɨhku kama
flagged.tl: He cleared the land alone in order to sow corn (lit.: do corn).
